description: This Java class defines an Android activity 'AppHwPref' that displays hardware configuration details of an application as specified in its manifest.

classes.name: AppHwPref
classes.description: An Android Activity that retrieves and displays hardware configuration preferences of a specific application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves package info, and displays hardware preferences.

methods.name: displayFlag
methods.description: Displays whether a specific hardware feature flag is set in the configuration info.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors by logging and optionally finishing the activity.

methods.name: displayTextView
methods.description: Sets text content of a TextView identified by viewId.

methods.name: displayTextView
methods.description: Displays a comma-separated list of configuration attributes based on type.

methods.name: getTouchScreenStr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the touchscreen configuration.

methods.name: getKeyboardTypeStr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the keyboard type configuration.

methods.name: getNavigationStr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the navigation configuration.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is resumed.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is stopped.
